edits.old: Stack Harbor’s guide, labeled updated February 17, 2026, presents Device Sync as an operational product, conflicting with MongoDB’s notice that it reached EOL on September 30, 2025. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-02-17)
edits.new: Stack Harbor's guide, labeled updated 2026-02-17, presents Atlas Device Sync as a working product for keeping a mobile app's local Realm database synchronized with Atlas. This conflicts with MongoDB's documentation, which says Device Sync has reached its end-of-life status. MongoDB's Device SDKs page gives September 30, 2025 as the date the Device SDKs reached end-of-life and were removed. Sources: https://stackharbor.com/en/knowledge-base/mongodb-atlas-sync-mobile/ ; https://mongodb.com/docs/atlas/app-services/sync/device-sync-deprecation ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/device-sdks/deprecation.md

evidence.quote: Use Atlas Device Sync (formerly Realm Sync) to keep a mobile app's local Realm database synchronized with Atlas
Device Sync has reached its end-of-life status. If you use Device Sync, migrate to one of the alternative solution providers listed below.
As of September 2024, Atlas Device SDKs are deprecated. Atlas Device SDKs reached end-of-life and were removed on September 30, 2025.

statements.statement: Stack Harbor's guide is labeled updated February 17, 2026 and presents Device Sync as an operational product.
statements.note: The page shows 'Updated 2026-02-17' and describes using Atlas Device Sync with no mention of end-of-life.

statements.statement: MongoDB's notice says Device Sync reached EOL on September 30, 2025.
statements.note: MongoDB says Device Sync has reached end-of-life. The pinned text gives September 30, 2025 only for the Device SDKs, not for Device Sync itself.

edits.rationale: The Stack Harbor page does show 'Updated 2026-02-17' and describes Device Sync as usable. MongoDB's Device Sync deprecation page says Device Sync has reached end-of-life, but the pinned text gives no date. The September 30, 2025 date appears in the pinned Device SDKs deprecation page, which covers the SDKs, not Device Sync itself, so the original claim's date for Device Sync is only partly supported.
